points.label: Action and response
points.left: Ahithophel proposes a swift strike on David; Hushai describes David’s danger, recommends gathering all Israel, and the text says the LORD has ordained defeat of the better counsel.
points.right: Hushai reports through priests and servants; Jonathan and Ahimaaz hide in a well, reach David, and prompt a river crossing, while Ahithophel dies and supporters bring beds and food.

payload.posture: 2 Samuel 17:1–14 and 2 Samuel 17:15–29 are distinct approved David Scenes in the authored “Exile, Return, and Rebellion” movement; holding them together exposes what continues and what changes without collapsing their sources.
